notes.title: Update 0.9.8.8
notes.notes:
Hi Agents!

Early Access 0.9.8.8 update for ''CodeRed: Agent Sarah's Story - Day One'' has landed on Steam. It contains small additions and improvements. We are only one small patch away from leaving EA. The game has been supplemented with all planned achievements and story options.
Let's play today 🙂

A list of changes:

- New game items have been added
- The pursuit has been improved

- Minor bugs fixed

Nice!

notes.title: New update: 0.9.5.0!
notes.notes:
Hello Agents, it's been awhile since the last update.

List of changes:

- The interface for witness interrogation has been changed and improved,
- Map traveling interface changed
- Some new gamplay elements added,
- Missing en translations added

- Map crash bug fixed!
- A few other annoying bugs fixed!

Enjoy!

notes.title: CodeRed - new update 0.8.5.0 out now!
